purpose: Mandatory cumulative learning, persistent supervision, cleanup and readiness contract for every Daily AI Brief production run.

supervisor.duplicate_run_policy: reject any second nonterminal execution; resume only exact same execution identity
supervisor.github_actions_job_rotation: Supervisor may rotate before GitHub-hosted job timeout; successor resumes same execution identity under a new fence.
supervisor.advancement: Immediately recheck after real task/image/result changes; sleep only on idle observation; elapsed-time job rotation.
supervisor.publication_boundary: Freeze candidate writes before Task 23, including lease acquisition and projection writes. Existing protected candidate workflow owns promotion; protected delta-validation finalization owns Task29.
supervisor.external_native_worker_handoff: A scheduled/native task worker must refresh durable state at invocation, acquire the current fenced writer generation for the same execution before mutation, never rely on a generation embedded at scheduling time, and release/expire its task-specific lease at a durable Done or Blocked boundary so supervision can resume.
supervisor.terminal_run_policy: All terminal production executions are immutable. Recovery may resume only the exact active nonterminal execution; otherwise allocation creates a new edition identity. Stale projections, pointers, worker requests, Kanban state, metrics or historical instructions can never reopen a terminal execution.
supervisor.observability_boundary: Kanban, timing targets, duration estimates and performance metrics are measurement only. They may trigger diagnosis but never block publication, change task state, authorize retries, create workers, consume retry budget, or reopen an execution.
supervisor.chatgpt_watchdog_fix_to_progress_rule: For an actionable stall, the outer Watchdog Ring must diagnose, fix, restore active execution, confirm a real executor, and verify durable progress. One failed attempt is never completion. Continue through safe authorized options; a safe boundary is an unresolved handoff, not success.
supervisor.chatgpt_watchdog_ring_image_consumer: All six slots A-F are functionally equivalent eligible native-image consumers for Tasks 11-16; the next eligible slot consumes an exact queued unclaimed request without waiting for a stale threshold.

operational_learning.task00: Read and validate full canonical ledger; bind digest/invariant set into readiness.
operational_learning.during_run: Append every material problem and fix attempt to the run-scoped durable GitHub delta as it occurs.
operational_learning.task29: Merge run delta into canonical ledger; reconcile every problem; add regression protection; update timing baseline and next-run invariants.
operational_learning.learning_completion_rule: A material production issue is not considered learned merely because the run advanced. Record it in the canonical JSONL and human projection during the run; when behavior changes, synchronize the living operations/readiness contract; record permanent implementation, regression protection and next-run validation or explicitly mark them pending.

improvement_board.task00: Reconcile the board against the canonical learning ledger; surface every unresolved ledger problem that is not represented on the board.
improvement_board.task29: Reconcile the completed execution learning delta into the canonical ledger and improvement board before certifying next-edition readiness.
improvement_board.lane_policy: Automated reconciliation annotates evidence and missing problems but never silently moves cards between lanes.

small_png_transport.identity_rule: Exact identity is mandatory for the final persisted PNG bytes. A bounded same-visual PNG representation may differ from native generation bytes only when professional composition/content are preserved, source-to-final lineage is recorded, and final Git bytes/read-back are verified.

host_admission.readiness_derivation: Task 00 loads the protected host registration, verifies its bound qualification receipt, verifies the committed reusable-consumer observation, then derives current host admission.
ready_requires: qualification receipt verifies PASS against immutable committed evidence
no Work, Codex, paid API, overage, new credential, owner upload or fallback violation
all six reusable_consumer.slots are enabled and native_image_eligible with exact minutes 03/13/23/33/43/53
one shared Watchdog recovery/consumer lease plus current production writer fence prevents duplicate image work
host_admission.production_mutation_authority: refreshed fenced lease acquired by scheduled consumer at invocation
host_admission.reusable_consumer_stable_schedule: six equivalent exact-hourly Watchdog Ring slots at minutes :03/:13/:23/:33/:43/:53; every slot is eligible for Tasks 11-16
host_admission.nonproduction_handoff_rehearsal_path: .github/workflows/run-supervisor-handoff.yml rehearsal/** branch-local pointer guarded by mode=NON_PRODUCTION, production_allocation=false, image_generation_allowed=false and synthetic execution identity

visible_text_guard.rule: When a story specification defines an exact visible-text allowlist, any additional language, pseudo-text, microcopy, faux document lines, code-like glyphs or text-like marks fail the candidate before final Git persistence.
visible_text_guard.primitive_rule: Document, card, ribbon and interface-like visual primitives must be text-free unless the specific visible label is allowlisted.
visible_text_guard.retry_policy: Use only the existing bounded attempt budget; simplify text-bearing primitives before reducing explanatory detail or professional quality.

summary_receipt_required_checks: qualification_source_commit and immutable_twelve_file_checkpoint match protected registration
zero generation/edit/normalization recovery and exact 12-file identity are asserted
six saved-Git reviews, owner quality confirmation and accepted finals remain bound
Work/Codex/paid API/new credentials/billing inference remain false
embedded verifier result is PASS with zero errors and recovered_file_count=12
completed one-time qualification scheduler observation digest and exact disabled task identity verify against qualification_source_commit
qualification_receipt_validation.raw_report_fallback: Only non-summary qualification inputs are passed to verifyUnattendedImageQualification.
qualification_receipt_validation.invariant: A protected PASS summary must never be reinterpreted as though it were the low-level verifier input schema.

kanban.nonterminal_total_time_rule: show live elapsed time from run start to observation timestamp
kanban.terminal_total_time_rule: show elapsed time from run start to terminal completion

terminal_cleanup.name: Run Cleanup + Continuous Improvement + Next-Run Readiness

image_qualification_metadata_corrections.scope: append-only correction of demonstrably wrong immutable image-attempt metadata during exact-byte qualification recovery
image_qualification_metadata_corrections.acceptance: A correction is admissible only when the committed receipt copy has the bound Git blob, the exact original bytes match byte count/SHA-256/Git blob, and PNG signature plus IHDR width/height match actual_dimensions.
